quality_tiers.gold: main stratum; exact relation; source quality gold
quality_tiers.silver: main stratum; censored relation or source quality silver
quality_tiers.auxiliary: valid measured activity but target outside the human single-protein stratum
quality_tiers.rejected: missing or rejected standardized structure, or invalid required activity field

discordance_rule.meaning: A spread of at least two log10 units (100-fold) is flagged for review; threshold-label conflicts are handled later in P3.
